TASK: Brandon decided on 2026-11-14 to DROP the layer 3 rule `unread_effect` ("a fact set and never read") from storygame/story_package/gap_rules.py. Reason: on the real continuity-initiative package it gave 68 results over 20 facts, mostly noise (pressure markers that only record an event fired); the useful results (declared costs/advantages nothing reads) are already reported by the branch report. The other rules (`custody`, `co_location`, `no_strand`, `single_reveal_strand`, `no_producer`) stay exactly as they are. Do exactly this:

1. In storygame/story_package/gap_rules.py delete `_unread_effect_flags`, `_run_unread_effect` and the `"unread_effect": _run_unread_effect` entry of the `RULES` dict. `_scoped_sets` exists only for `unread_effect`: confirm with grep (`grep -n _scoped_sets storygame -r`) and delete it too, and delete any other helper, import or constant that is left with no user after these deletions (ruff will flag unused imports; for functions grep every name before deleting, and keep anything another rule or another module still uses, for example `consumers`, `producers` and `_anchor_matches` are used by `no_producer`). Do not change the behavior or text of any other rule. Do not reformat unrelated code. Update the module docstring or comments only if they name `unread_effect`.
2. In tests/test_gap_rules.py:
   a. Delete `test_unread_effect_seeded_defect_and_clean_variant` (near line 221), and any helper used only by it.
   b. `test_real_dependency_results_match_the_audit_inventory` (near line 247) pins the unread_effect results. Rename it `test_real_package_has_no_producer_results_for_every_anchor`, delete the whole `expected_by_anchor` table and the `expected` set built from it, keep the anchor list (every pacing event, incident and transition id), and assert that `run_gap_rules(ROOT, anchor, ["no_producer"])` returns an empty list for every anchor, with an assertion message that names the anchor and subject of any result.
   c. Add one small test that `run_gap_rules(ROOT, "pursuit_1b", ["unread_effect"])` raises ValueError (the rule no longer exists), using pytest.raises with match="unknown rule".
   d. Leave the `no_producer` seeded-defect and clean-variant tests and every other test unchanged.
3. Run `grep -rn unread_effect storygame tests scripts/gap_rules.py` : the only remaining hit may be the string in the new test 2c.
4. Run the focused tests: tests/test_gap_rules.py tests/test_impact_report.py tests/test_branch_report.py tests/test_situation_trace.py, then `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check storygame tests` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check storygame tests`. Fix what you broke; if a failure is unrelated to this change, say so in your final message instead of changing it.
Leave all changes uncommitted.
